text:
Type: molded plastic tub armchair with seat cushion
Use: casual sitting, lounging; living room, playroom, balcony
Style: retro, modern, contemporary
Materials: glossy molded plastic shell and base, round tufted fabric seat pad
Colors: bright white, charcoal black cushion
Shape: rounded tub seat with low curved arms rising into the back, ribbed cylindrical body, wide round disc foot, thick round cushion, compact and chunky
Feel: playful, graphic, fun, sculptural
Goes with: black and white schemes, bold colors, white walls; retro, modern or playful rooms, kids' rooms
